Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing continuing education requirements for engineers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing continuing education requirementsfor engineers; creating a new section; and providing an expirationdate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of licensing shall submitrecommendations to the legislature on establishing continuing educationrequirements for engineers using the public criteria set forth in RCW18.118.010. (2) In developing the recommendations, the department of licensingshall consult with registered engineers and other stakeholders. (3) The department of licensing shall submit a report detailing itsfindings and recommendations under this section to the appropriatelegislative committees by December 1, 2010. (4) This section expires July 1, 2011.
